metadata.name: cross_core
metadata.description: Opening Cross core: escrow, commit-reveal order entry, sharded aggregation, uniform-price clearing, claims and refunds.

instructions.name: abandon_settlement
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: if no base mint was bound by the deadline, anyone may abandon
settlement; the cross becomes a no-print and every order is refunded in full.

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step: the proposed admin signs to take over.

instructions.name: bind_base_mint
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: the registered settler binds the base mint it created after the
clear. The cross PDA must already hold the mint authority.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Withdraws an order during the call window. Full refund, no fee.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Settles one order: pays its fill at the clearing price and refunds the rest. Anyone may
crank it; funds always go to the order owner. Closes the order account.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may crank; pays for any missing owner token account.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Omitted only when nothing is paid in base (refunds of a deferred-mint cross).

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Escrow mode only.

accounts.name: owner_base
docs: The owner's base account (create it first; the SDK adds an idempotent ATA creation).

instructions.name: clear
docs: Clears the cross once every shard is merged. Permissionless.

accounts.name: oracle_price
docs: pinned feed (typically posted by the keeper in the same transaction); ownership, feed,
verification level and freshness are checked in `oracle_verdict`.

instructions.name: commit_order
docs: Places an order and escrows its funds. Sealed crosses take a commitment; open crosses
take the plaintext `price` and `quantity` and add them to the book immediately.

accounts.name: order
docs: client-supplied bump, which `create_program_address` verifies (no bump search).

accounts.name: shard
docs: Required for open disclosure (the order's shard); omitted for sealed crosses.

accounts.name: escrow_mint
docs: cross in the handler, decimals come from the cross.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: handler and by the token program on transfer.

accounts.name: owner_escrow
docs: owner signs for it and that its mint matches.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Omitted for deferred-mint crosses.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Distributes what is left once every order has been claimed: the issuer's proceeds and
fees in mint mode, accrued fees in escrow mode, the dust and bond remainder to
`proceeds_to`; then revokes the cross's mint authority in mint mode.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Required whenever the cross has a bound base mint.

accounts.name: base_vault
docs: Escrow mode only.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: integrator_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: proceeds_quote
docs: May be the same account as the other payout accounts (e.g. an issuer acting as its own
integrator); Anchor never writes token accounts back, so aliasing is safe.

accounts.name: proceeds_base
docs: Escrow mode only (receives base dust).

instructions.name: merge_shard
docs: Adds one shard into the book. Permissionless; each shard merges exactly once.

instructions.name: migrate_protocol
docs: Brings a protocol account written by an earlier layout up to the current one. Only the
stored admin may run it; it grows the account (the admin pays the extra rent) and sets every
field added since to its default. Idempotent: a current account is left unchanged.

accounts.name: protocol
docs: account may not deserialize under the current layout, which is why it is migrated).

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of an admin handover (e.g. to a multisig vault). Nothing changes until the
proposed admin accepts, so a mistyped address cannot lock the protocol. `None` withdraws it.

instructions.name: reveal_order
docs: Reveals a sealed order during the reveal window and adds it to its shard.

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: The admin may rotate the guardian (the key allowed to pause new activity).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Guardian or admin pause of new crosses and new orders. Reveals, clears, claims and
refunds are never paused.

instructions.name: set_protocol_fees
docs: Fee changes apply to crosses created afterwards; existing crosses keep their snapshot.

types.name: ClearingSummary
docs: Clearing summary stored on the cross; mirrors `clearing_core::Clearing`.

fields.name: rationed
docs: 0 = none, 1 = buy, 2 = sell.

types.name: CommitOrderArgs
docs: Arguments for `commit_order`. Sealed crosses send the commitment and leave `price` and
`quantity` zero; open crosses send the plaintext order and a zero commitment.

fields.name: order_bump
docs: Bump of the order PDA, computed by the client.

fields.name: reveal_end_ts
docs: Ignored (set to `close_ts`) for open disclosure.

fields.name: calendar
docs: Schedule the cross on this calendar: its close must be a session start, and its oracle
feed (if any) must be approved by the calendar.

fields.name: schedule
docs: Mint modes only: the issuer's elastic supply schedule as sell levels.

fields.name: settler
docs: Deferred-mint mode only: the adapter authority allowed to bind the base mint.

fields.name: settle_deadline_ts
docs: Deferred-mint mode only: after this time an unbound cross can be abandoned and refunded.

fields.name: proceeds_to
docs: Receives the issuer's proceeds in mint mode and the dust/bond remainder in all modes.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Price grid: `min_price + i * tick` for `i < ticks`. Prices are quote atoms per
`price_scale` base atoms.

fields.name: gate_mint
docs: When set, only owners holding a `cross_gate` pass for this mint may place orders.

fields.name: buyer_paid
docs: Running settlement totals.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Optional oracle divergence guard (reopens of assets with a reference market).

fields.name: calendar
docs: Exchange calendar the cross is scheduled on (`cross_calendar`), if any.

fields.name: settler
docs: Deferred-mint crosses: the only signer allowed to bind the base mint, and the deadline
after which anyone may abandon settlement and refund every order.

fields.name: base_bound
docs: False until a deferred-mint cross has its base mint bound.

types.name: Levels
docs: Per-tick aggregates. Used both for shards (written by orders) and the merged book.

types.name: OracleGuard
docs: Pyth price guard: the cross does not print if P* differs from the oracle by more than
`max_divergence_bps`, or if no fully verified price newer than `max_staleness_secs` exists.
The guard pins the Pyth **feed id**, not an account: Pyth's sponsored push accounts for US
equities were 24–40 days stale on mainnet (DP15), so the clearing keeper posts a fresh update
through the Pyth receiver (pull model) and passes that account. The receiver verifies the
Wormhole signatures; the guard accepts only fully verified updates for the pinned feed.

fields.name: commitment
docs: Sealed crosses: `sha256(cross ‖ owner ‖ nonce ‖ side ‖ price ‖ quantity ‖ salt)`.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Quote atoms (buys) or base atoms (sells) held in the vault for this order.

fields.name: guardian
docs: May pause new crosses and orders; can never block claims or refunds.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in bps of filled notional, indexed by [`CrossKind`].

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin; takes over only when it signs `accept_admin` (two-step handover).

types.name: SupplyLevel
docs: One step of an issuer's pre-committed supply schedule.
